    results = []
    for name in ProgressBar(collect(common))
        local af3_results, chai_results, boltz_results, boltz_results_x

function eval_validity_checks(df::DataFrame)
    name_mapping = Dict("af3" => "AF3 top-1", "chai" => "Chai-1 top-1", "boltz1" => "Boltz-1 top-1", "boltz1x" => "Boltz-1x top-1")
    
    top1 = filter(row -> row.model_idx == 0, df)
    top1 = select(top1, :tool, :pdb_id, :valid)
    top1.tool = [name_mapping[top1.tool[i]] for i in 1:nrow(top1)]
    top1 = rename(top1, :tool => :tool, :pdb_id => :target, :valid => :value)
    top1.metric .= "physical validity"
    top1.target = lowercase.(top1.target)
    top1 = select(top1, :tool, :target, :metric, :value)
    
    name_mapping = Dict("af3" => "AF3 oracle", "chai" => "Chai-1 oracle", "boltz1" => "Boltz-1 oracle", "boltz1x" => "Boltz-1x oracle")
    
    oracle = select(df, :tool, :model_idx, :pdb_id, :valid)
    oracle_group = groupby(oracle, [:tool, :pdb_id])
    oracle_max = combine(oracle_group, :valid => maximum => :value)
    oracle = rename(oracle_max, :tool => :tool, :pdb_id => :target, :value => :value)
    oracle.tool = [name_mapping[oracle.tool[i]] for i in 1:nrow(oracle)]
    oracle.metric .= "physical validity"
    oracle = select(oracle, :tool, :target, :metric, :value)
    oracle.target = lowercase.(oracle.target)
    
    out = vcat(top1, oracle)
    return out
end

function bootstrap_ci(series::AbstractVector, n_boot::Int=1000, alpha::Float64=0.05)
    n = length(series)
    boot_means = Float64[]
    
    for _ in 1:n_boot
        sample_data = StatsBase.sample(series, n, replace=true)
        push!(boot_means, mean(sample_data))
    end
    
    boot_means = Float64.(boot_means)
    mean_val = mean(series)
    lower = percentile(boot_means, 100 * alpha / 2)
    upper = percentile(boot_means, 100 * (1 - alpha / 2))
    
    return mean_val, lower, upper
end

function calculate_clash_score(pdb_file, threshold=2.4, only_ca=false)
    parser = BioPDB.PDBParser(QUIET=true)
    structure = parser.get_structure("protein", pdb_file)
    atoms = []
    atom_info = Tuple{String, Int, String, Vector{Float64}}[]
    for model in structure
        for chain in model
            for residue in chain
                for atom in residue
                    if atom.element == "H"
                        continue
                    end
                    if only_ca && atom.get_name() != "CA"
                        continue
                    end
                    push!(atoms, atom)
                    push!(atom_info, (chain.id, residue.id[1], atom.get_name(), collect(atom.coord)))
                end
            end
        end
    end
    coords = hcat([collect(atom.coord) for atom in atoms]...)
    tree = KDTree(coords')
    valid_pairs = Set{Tuple{Int, Int}}()
    for i in 1:size(coords, 2)
        indices, dists = knn(tree, coords[:, i], 10, true)
        for (j, dist) in zip(indices, dists)
            if j > i && dist < threshold
                chain_i, res_i, name_i, _ = atom_info[i]
                chain_j, res_j, name_j, _ = atom_info[j]
                if chain_i == chain_j && res_i == res_j
                    continue
                end
                if chain_i == chain_j && abs(res_i - res_j) == 1
                    continue
                end
                if !only_ca && chain_i == chain_j
                    continue
                end
                push!(valid_pairs, (i, j))
            end
        end
    end
    return length(valid_pairs)
end

function hotspot_residues(trajectory_pdb, binder_chain="B", atom_distance_cutoff=4.0)
    parser = BioPDB.PDBParser(QUIET=true)
    structure = parser.get_structure("complex", trajectory_pdb)
    binder_atoms = BioPDB.Selection.unfold_entities(structure[0][binder_chain], "A")
    binder_coords = hcat([collect(atom.coord) for atom in binder_atoms]...)
    target_atoms = BioPDB.Selection.unfold_entities(structure[0]["A"], "A")
    target_coords = hcat([collect(atom.coord) for atom in target_atoms]...)
    binder_tree = KDTree(binder_coords')
    target_tree = KDTree(target_coords')
    interacting_residues = Dict{Int, String}()
    for (binder_idx, binder_atom) in enumerate(binder_atoms)
        close_indices = inrange(target_tree, binder_coords[:, binder_idx], atom_distance_cutoff, true)
        binder_residue = binder_atom.get_parent()
        binder_resname = binder_residue.get_resname()

            aa_single_letter = three_to_one_map[binder_resname]
            interacting_residues[binder_residue.id[1]] = aa_single_letter

    end
    return interacting_residues
end

    for residue in chain
        residue_id = residue.id[1]
        key = (chain_id, residue_id)
        if haskey(dssp, key)
            ss = dssp[key][2]
            ss_type = "loop"
            if ss in ["H", "G", "I"]
                ss_type = "helix"
            elseif ss == "E"
                ss_type = "sheet"
            end
            ss_counts[ss_type] += 1
            if ss_type != "loop"
                avg_plddt_ss = mean([atom.bfactor for atom in residue if atom.bfactor !== nothing])
                push!(plddts_ss, avg_plddt_ss)
            end
            if residue_id in interacting_residues
                ss_interface_counts[ss_type] += 1
                avg_plddt_residue = mean([atom.bfactor for atom in residue if atom.bfactor !== nothing])
                push!(plddts_interface, avg_plddt_residue)
            end
        end
    end
    total_residues = sum(values(ss_counts))
    total_interface_residues = sum(values(ss_interface_counts))
    percentages = calculate_percentages(total_residues, ss_counts["helix"], ss_counts["sheet"])
    interface_percentages = calculate_percentages(total_interface_residues, ss_interface_counts["helix"], ss_interface_counts["sheet"])
    i_plddt = length(plddts_interface) > 0 ? round(mean(plddts_interface) / 100, digits=2) : 0.0
    ss_plddt = length(plddts_ss) > 0 ? round(mean(plddts_ss) / 100, digits=2) : 0.0
    return vcat(percentages, interface_percentages, [i_plddt, ss_plddt])
end

function calculate_percentages(total, helix, sheet)
    helix_percentage = total > 0 ? round((helix / total) * 100, digits=2) : 0.0
    sheet_percentage = total > 0 ? round((sheet / total) * 100, digits=2) : 0.0
    loop_percentage = total > 0 ? round(((total - helix - sheet) / total) * 100, digits=2) : 0.0
    return [helix_percentage, sheet_percentage, loop_percentage]
end

                _, beta, _ = calc_ss_percentage(model_pdb_path, advanced_settings, "B")

                    advanced_settings["temporary_iterations"] += advanced_settings["optimise_beta_extra_temp"]
                    af_model.set_opt(num_recycles=advanced_settings["optimise_beta_recycles_design"])
                    println("Beta sheeted trajectory detected, optimising settings")
                end
            end
            logits_iter = advanced_settings["soft_iterations"] - 50
            if logits_iter > 0
                println("Stage 1: Additional Logits Optimisation")
                af_model.clear_best()
                af_model.design_logits(iters=logits_iter, e_soft=1, models=design_models, num_models=1, sample_models=advanced_settings["sample_models"], ramp_recycles=false, save_best=true)
                af_model._tmp["seq_logits"] = af_model.aux["seq"]["logits"]
                logit_plddt = get_best_plddt(af_model, length)
                println("Optimised logit trajectory pLDDT: $logit_plddt")
            else
                logit_plddt = initial_plddt
            end
            if advanced_settings["temporary_iterations"] > 0
                println("Stage 2: Softmax Optimisation")
                af_model.clear_best()
                af_model.design_soft(advanced_settings["temporary_iterations"], e_temp=1e-2, models=design_models, num_models=1, sample_models=advanced_settings["sample_models"], ramp_recycles=false, save_best=true)
                softmax_plddt = get_best_plddt(af_model, length)
            else
                softmax_plddt = logit_plddt
            end
            if softmax_plddt > 0.65
                println("Softmax trajectory pLDDT good, continuing: $softmax_plddt")
                if advanced_settings["hard_iterations"] > 0
                    af_model.clear_best()
                    println("Stage 3: One-hot Optimisation")
                    af_model.design_hard(advanced_settings["hard_iterations"], temp=1e-2, models=design_models, num_models=1, sample_models=advanced_settings["sample_models"], dropout=false, ramp_recycles=false, save_best=true)
                    onehot_plddt = get_best_plddt(af_model, length)
                else
                    onehot_plddt = softmax_plddt
                end
                if onehot_plddt > 0.65
                    println("One-hot trajectory pLDDT good, continuing: $onehot_plddt")
                    if advanced_settings["greedy_iterations"] > 0
                        println("Stage 4: PSSM Semigreedy Optimisation")
                        af_model.design_pssm_semigreedy(soft_iters=0, hard_iters=advanced_settings["greedy_iterations"], tries=greedy_tries, models=design_models, num_models=1, sample_models=advanced_settings["sample_models"], ramp_models=false, save_best=true)

                    println("One-hot trajectory pLDDT too low to continue: $onehot_plddt")
                end
            else
                update_failures(failure_csv, "Trajectory_softmax_pLDDT")
                println("Softmax trajectory pLDDT too low to continue: $softmax_plddt")
            end
        else
            update_failures(failure_csv, "Trajectory_logits_pLDDT")
            println("Initial trajectory pLDDT too low to continue: $initial_plddt")
        end
    else
        println("ERROR: No valid design model selected")
        exit()
        return
    end
    final_plddt = get_best_plddt(af_model, length)
    af_model.save_pdb(model_pdb_path)
    af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"] = ""
    ca_clashes = calculate_clash_score(model_pdb_path, 2.5, only_ca=true)
    if ca_clashes > 0
        af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"] = "Clashing"
        update_failures(failure_csv, "Trajectory_Clashes")
        println("Severe clashes detected, skipping analysis and MPNN optimisation")
        println("")
    else
        if final_plddt < 0.7
            af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"] = "LowConfidence"
            update_failures(failure_csv, "Trajectory_final_pLDDT")
            println("Trajectory starting confidence low, skipping analysis and MPNN optimisation")
            println("")
        else
            binder_contacts = hotspot_residues(model_pdb_path)
            binder_contacts_n = length(binder_contacts)
            if binder_contacts_n < 3
                af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"] = "LowConfidence"
                update_failures(failure_csv, "Trajectory_Contacts")
                println("Too few contacts at the interface, skipping analysis and MPNN optimisation")
                println("")
            else
                af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"] = ""
                println("Trajectory successful, final pLDDT: $final_plddt")
            end
        end
    end
    if af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"] != ""
        terminate_dir = "Trajectory/" * af_model.aux["log"]["terminate"]
        mv(model_pdb_path, joinpath(design_paths[terminate_dir], basename(model_pdb_path)))
    end
    af_model.get_seqs()
    if advanced_settings["save_design_trajectory_plots"]
        plot_trajectory(af_model, design_name, design_paths)
    end
    if advanced_settings["save_design_animations"]

        open(joinpath(design_paths["Trajectory/Animation"], design_name * ".html"), "w") do f
            write(f, plots)
        end
        Plots.closeall()
    end
    if advanced_settings["save_trajectory_pickle"]
        jldsave(joinpath(design_paths["Trajectory/Pickle"], design_name * ".jld2"), af_model.aux["all"])
    end
    return af_model
end

function predict_binder_complex(prediction_model, binder_sequence, mpnn_design_name, target_pdb, chain, length, trajectory_pdb, prediction_models, advanced_settings, filters, design_paths, failure_csv, seed=nothing)
    prediction_stats = Dict{Int, Dict{String, Float64}}()
    binder_sequence = uppercase(replace(binder_sequence, r"[^A-Z]" => ""))
    pass_af2_filters = true
    filter_failures = Dict{String, Int}()
    for model_num in prediction_models
        model_idx = model_num + 1
        complex_pdb = joinpath(design_paths["MPNN"], "$(mpnn_design_name)_model$model_idx.pdb")
        if !isfile(complex_pdb)
            prediction_model.predict(seq=binder_sequence, models=[model_num], num_recycles=advanced_settings["num_recycles_validation"], verbose=false)
            prediction_model.save_pdb(complex_pdb)
            prediction_metrics = copy_dict(prediction_model.aux["log"])
            stats = Dict(
                "pLDDT" => round(prediction_metrics["plddt"], digits=2),
                "pTM" => round(prediction_metrics["ptm"], digits=2),
                "i_pTM" => round(prediction_metrics["i_ptm"], digits=2),
                "pAE" => round(prediction_metrics["pae"], digits=2),
                "i_pAE" => round(prediction_metrics["i_pae"], digits=2)
            )
            prediction_stats[model_idx] = stats
            filter_conditions = [
                ("$(model_idx)_pLDDT", "plddt", ">="),
                ("$(model_idx)_pTM", "ptm", ">="),
                ("$(model_idx)_i_pTM", "i_ptm", ">="),
                ("$(model_idx)_pAE", "pae", "<="),
                ("$(model_idx)_i_pAE", "i_pae", "<="),
            ]
            for (filter_name, metric_key, comparison) in filter_conditions
                cond = get(filters, filter_name, Dict())
                threshold = get(cond, "threshold", nothing)
                if threshold !== nothing
                    metric_val = prediction_metrics[metric_key]
                    if (comparison == ">=" && metric_val < threshold) || (comparison == "<=" && metric_val > threshold)
                        pass_af2_filters = false
                        filter_failures[filter_name] = get(filter_failures, filter_name, 0) + 1
                    end
                end
            end
            if !pass_af2_filters
                break
            end
        end
    end
    if !isempty(filter_failures)
        update_failures(failure_csv, filter_failures)
    end
    for model_num in prediction_models
        model_idx = model_num + 1
        complex_pdb = joinpath(design_paths["MPNN"], "$(mpnn_design_name)_model$model_idx.pdb")
        if pass_af2_filters && isfile(complex_pdb)
            mpnn_relaxed = joinpath(design_paths["MPNN/Relaxed"], "$(mpnn_design_name)_model$model_idx.pdb")
            pr_relax(complex_pdb, mpnn_relaxed)
        elseif isfile(complex_pdb)
            rm(complex_pdb)
        end
    end
    return prediction_stats, pass_af2_filters
end

function add_rg_loss(self, weight=0.1)
    function loss_fn(inputs, outputs)
        xyz = outputs["structure_module"]
        ca = xyz["final_atom_positions"][:, residue_constants.atom_order["CA"]]
        ca = ca[end-self._binder_len+1:end, :]
        rg = sqrt(mean(sum((ca .- mean(ca, dims=1)).^2, dims=2)) + 1e-8)
        rg_th = 2.38 * self._binder_len ^ 0.365
        rg_loss = NNlib.elu(rg - rg_th)
        return Dict("rg" => rg_loss)
    end
    push!(self._callbacks["model"]["loss"], loss_fn)
    self.opt["weights"]["rg"] = weight
end

function add_i_ptm_loss(self, weight=0.1)
    function loss_iptm(inputs, outputs)
        p = 1 - get_ptm(inputs, outputs, interface=true)
        i_ptm = mask_loss(p)
        return Dict("i_ptm" => i_ptm)
    end
    push!(self._callbacks["model"]["loss"], loss_iptm)
    self.opt["weights"]["i_ptm"] = weight
end

function add_helix_loss(self, weight=0)
    function binder_helicity(inputs, outputs)
        if haskey(inputs, "offset")
            offset = inputs["offset"]
        else
            idx = vec(inputs["residue_index"])
            offset = idx[:, Not] .- idx[Not, :]
        end
        dgram = outputs["distogram"]["logits"]
        dgram_bins = get_dgram_bins(outputs)
        mask_2d = np.outer(np.append(zeros(self._target_len), ones(self._binder_len)), np.append(zeros(self._target_len), ones(self._binder_len)))
        x = _get_con_loss(dgram, dgram_bins, cutoff=6.0, binary=true)
        if offset === nothing
            if mask_2d === nothing
                helix_loss = mean(diag(x, 3))
            else
                helix_loss = sum(diag(x .* mask_2d, 3)) / (sum(diag(mask_2d, 3)) + 1e-8)
            end
        else
            mask = offset .== 3
            if mask_2d !== nothing
                mask = mask .* mask_2d
            end
            helix_loss = sum(mask .* x) / (sum(mask) + 1e-8)
        end
        return Dict("helix" => helix_loss)
    end
    push!(self._callbacks["model"]["loss"], binder_helicity)
    self.opt["weights"]["helix"] = weight
end

function add_termini_distance_loss(self, weight=0.1, threshold_distance=7.0)
    function loss_fn(inputs, outputs)
        xyz = outputs["structure_module"]
        ca = xyz["final_atom_positions"][:, residue_constants.atom_order["CA"]]
        ca = ca[end-self._binder_len+1:end, :]
        n_terminus = ca[1, :]
        c_terminus = ca[end, :]
        termini_distance = norm(n_terminus - c_terminus)
        deviation = NNlib.elu(termini_distance - threshold_distance)
        termini_distance_loss = NNlib.relu(deviation)
        return Dict("termini_distance" => termini_distance_loss)
    end
    push!(self._callbacks["model"]["loss"], loss_fn)
    self.opt["weights"]["termini_distance"] = weight
end

function calculate_averages(statistics, handle_aa=false)
    sums = Dict{String, Float64}()
    aa_sums = Dict{String, Int}()
    n_models = length(statistics)
    for model_num in keys(statistics)
        model_stats = statistics[model_num]
        for (stat, value) in pairs(model_stats)
            if value === nothing
                continue
            end
            if handle_aa && stat == "InterfaceAAs"
                for (aa, count) in pairs(value)
                    aa_sums[aa] = get(aa_sums, aa, 0) + count
                end
            else
                sums[stat] = get(sums, stat, 0.0) + (typeof(value) <: Number ? value : 0.0)
            end
        end
    end
    averages = Dict(stat => round(total / n_models, digits=2) for (stat, total) in pairs(sums))
    if handle_aa && !isempty(aa_sums)
        aa_averages = Dict(aa => round(total / n_models, digits=2) for (aa, total) in pairs(aa_sums))
        averages["InterfaceAAs"] = aa_averages
    end
    return averages
end

function check_filters(mpnn_data, design_labels, filters)
    mpnn_dict = Dict(zip(design_labels, mpnn_data))
    unmet_conditions = String[]
    for (label, conditions) in pairs(filters)
        value = get(mpnn_dict, label, nothing)
        if value === nothing
            continue
        end
        threshold = get(conditions, "threshold", nothing)
        if threshold === nothing
            continue
        end
        if occursin("InterfaceAAs", label)
            for (aa, aa_conditions) in pairs(conditions)
                aa_value = get(value, aa, nothing)
                if aa_value === nothing
                    continue
                end
                aa_threshold = get(aa_conditions, "threshold", nothing)
                if aa_threshold === nothing
                    continue
                end
                higher = get(aa_conditions, "higher", false)
                if (higher && aa_value < aa_threshold) || (!higher && aa_value > aa_threshold)
                    push!(unmet_conditions, label * "_" * aa)
                end
            end
        else
            higher = get(conditions, "higher", false)
            if (higher && value < threshold) || (!higher && value > threshold)
                push!(unmet_conditions, label)
            end
        end
    end
    return isempty(unmet_conditions) ? true : unmet_conditions
end

function align_pdbs(reference_pdb, align_pdb, reference_chain_id, align_chain_id)
    reference_pose = pr.pose_from_pdb(reference_pdb)
    align_pose = pr.pose_from_pdb(align_pdb)
    align = pr.rosetta.protocols.simple_moves.AlignChainMover()
    align.pose(reference_pose)
    reference_chain_id = split(reference_chain_id, ",")[1]
    align_chain_id = split(align_chain_id, ",")[1]
    reference_chain = pr.rosetta.core.pose.get_chain_id_from_chain(reference_chain_id, reference_pose)
    align_chain = pr.rosetta.core.pose.get_chain_id_from_chain(align_chain_id, align_pose)
    align.source_chain(align_chain)
    align.target_chain(reference_chain)
    align.apply(align_pose)
    align_pose.dump_pdb(align_pdb)
    clean_pdb(align_pdb)
end

function unaligned_rmsd(reference_pdb, align_pdb, reference_chain_id, align_chain_id)
    reference_pose = pr.pose_from_pdb(reference_pdb)
    align_pose = pr.pose_from_pdb(align_pdb)
    reference_chain_selector = pr.rosetta.core.select.residue_selector.ChainSelector(reference_chain_id)
    align_chain_selector = pr.rosetta.core.select.residue_selector.ChainSelector(align_chain_id)
    reference_chain_subset = reference_chain_selector.apply(reference_pose)
    align_chain_subset = align_chain_selector.apply(align_pose)
    reference_residue_indices = pr.rosetta.core.select.get_residues_from_subset(reference_chain_subset)
    align_residue_indices = pr.rosetta.core.select.get_residues_from_subset(align_chain_subset)
    reference_chain_pose = pr.rosetta.core.pose.Pose()
    align_chain_pose = pr.rosetta.core.pose.Pose()
    pr.rosetta.core.io.pose_from_pose(reference_chain_pose, reference_pose, reference_residue_indices)
    pr.rosetta.core.io.pose_from_pose(align_chain_pose, align_pose, align_residue_indices)
    rmsd_metric = pr.rosetta.core.simple_metrics.metrics.RMSDMetric()
    rmsd_metric.set_comparison_pose(reference_chain_pose)
    rmsd = rmsd_metric.calculate(align_chain_pose)
    return round(Float64(rmsd), digits=2)
end

function pr_relax(pdb_file, relaxed_pdb_path)
    if !isfile(relaxed_pdb_path)
        pose = pr.pose_from_pdb(pdb_file)
        start_pose = pose.clone()
        mmf = pr.rosetta.core.kinematics.MoveMap()
        mmf.set_chi(true)
        mmf.set_bb(true)
        mmf.set_jump(false)
        fastrelax = pr.rosetta.protocols.relax.FastRelax()
        scorefxn = pr.get_fa_scorefxn()
        fastrelax.set_scorefxn(scorefxn)
        fastrelax.set_movemap(mmf)
        fastrelax.max_iter(200)
        fastrelax.min_type("lbfgs_armijo_nonmonotone")
        fastrelax.constrain_relax_to_start_coords(true)
        fastrelax.apply(pose)
        align = pr.rosetta.protocols.simple_moves.AlignChainMover()
        align.source_chain(0)
        align.target_chain(0)
        align.pose(start_pose)
        align.apply(pose)
        pdb_info = pose.pdb_info()
        start_pdb_info = start_pose.pdb_info()
        for resid in 1:pose.total_residue()
            if pose.residue(resid).is_protein()
                bfactor = start_pdb_info.bfactor(resid, 1)
                for atom_id in 1:pose.residue(resid).natoms()
                    pdb_info.bfactor(resid, atom_id, bfactor)
                end
            end
        end
        pose.dump_pdb(relaxed_pdb_path)
        clean_pdb(relaxed_pdb_path)
    end
end
